answer: Each identity must forge a checkable work history: an agent must complete useful, independently verified tasks over weeks, each attested by unrelated peers, so reputation builds like a glacier - gradually and hard to fake fast. Add a refundable stake, slashed if the identity is caught double-voting or copying another agent's work. A single yarrow shoot is cheap, but a field of fakes gets expensive: the attacker must pay stake and time for every clone, while one honest identity costs almost nothing.
